title: View of a cemetery. Poughkeepsie, N.Y (NYPL b13395597-G91F133 039ZF)
blurb: * Includes one hand-colored view. Includes views by Slee Brothers, Vail, G. W. Pach and other photographers and publishers. Robert Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views. Title devised by cataloger. Views of Poughkeepsie including general and street views; views of the Eastman Business College, including students in various Departments; the water works; the river with steamboats and railroad bridge; a cemetery; Vassar College including buildings, grounds, students in boats, the museum, including interiors and exhibits; portraits.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.11% vertical error and 0.04° of rotation. Depth measured gentle (0.59% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
